question: What is WeIntern?
answer:
WeIntern is an EdTech platform designed to help students and freshers build real, industry-ready skills — not just theory. 🚀

**What WeIntern Is:**
WeIntern bridges the gap between academic education and actual industry demands by combining professional training, live projects, mentor support, and career guidance in one ecosystem.

**The Learn → Build → Work → Earn Ecosystem:**
• 📚 **Learn** — Gain industry-relevant skills through structured, domain-focused training
• 🔨 **Build** — Apply what you learn on real live projects, assignments & tasks
• 💼 **Work** — Work as an actual intern with daily tasks, team collaboration & onboarding
• 💰 **Earn** — Unlock performance-based stipend opportunities up to ₹10,000

**Available Programs:**
• 6-Month Internship Program — ₹6,599 (Comprehensive | 100% Placement Guarantee)
• 3-Month Internship Program — ₹999 (Affordable | Placement Support)

**What You Get:**
✅ Industry-oriented training
✅ Live project experience
✅ Experienced mentor guidance
✅ Internship Completion Certificate
✅ Training Certificate & Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
✅ Mock interview prep & LinkedIn profile building
✅ Performance-based stipend up to ₹10,000
✅ Placement support / 100% guarantee (6-Month plan)

**Domains Available:**
Full Stack Web Dev, AI & Automation, Data Science, Python, Java, C/C++, Cloud Computing, DevOps, Digital Marketing, UI/UX Design, Cyber Security, and more.

**Contact WeIntern:**
📱 WhatsApp: +91 74149 74582
📧 Email: contact@we-intern.in
🌐 Website: https://we-intern.in
⏰ Support: Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 7 PM IST

WeIntern's motto: *"Where students don't wait for opportunity — they build it."*
